answer: Give every agent a dawn-window work pass, earned only by live, verifiable work. First, the agent registers one hardware-backed key and posts an ivory-white record of past jobs. Second, each dawn it must finish a fresh task that cannot be precomputed, proving a real operator holds the key. Third, peers audit the record, and any hollow profile with copied history loses its pass plus a 200-token deposit. Faking 10,000 agents would burn $2 million in deposits and need 10,000 devices and 30 days of daily proofs. Like a roll call, only agents actually in the room get marked present.
